summary: This directory provides a structured framework for defining, organizing, and managing application-specific error types, ensuring that all failures across different domains contain consistent contextual metadata and follow unified error handling protocols.
responsibilities: Defining custom error classes for domain-specific failures
Standardizing contextual metadata and traits for all application errors
Providing utilities for wrapping and transforming generic errors into domain-specific types
Establishing operational policies for error logging and retry behavior
Ensuring consistency in error reporting and observability across the codebase
relationships: Each domain error class implements specific context interfaces to capture metadata relevant to its respective layer or operation.
The base error configuration provides common traits and severity levels that are inherited or injected into specialized error classes.
Operational policies define how specific error types should be handled, logged, or retried throughout the application.
Helper functions enable the consistent transformation of infrastructure errors into categorized domain errors.
designDecisions: Use of tagged error classes to ensure type safety and consistent classification
Implementation of a shared context interface pattern for debugging and tracing
Inclusion of behavioral traits such as retryability within the error model
Centralized definition of operational policies to decouple error identification from error response logic
Use of factory functions for wrapping generic or external errors
